review: fresh independent source review of EXT-F-2005-T08 outgoing organization-header oracle

verdict_a_behavior.finding: The observer reads the outgoing request's X-Organization-Id from the real CDP Network.requestWillBeSent request object and evaluates it against both the captured POST body organization_id and the independently supplied selected organization. The test cases distinguish correct, case-insensitive, wrong, missing, and body/header-agree-but-selected-wrong states. The native acceptance assertion is now immediately after the unique successful owned-write snapshot and before target selection, lookup, or success observations.
evidence: The observer filters requests to the configured Supabase origin, /rest/v1/wbx_pattern, and POST, then captures request headers from Network.requestWillBeSent and obtains a missing inline request body through Network.getRequestPostData.

Snapshot output contains only presence/match booleans, status, failure state, and bounded capture labels; it does not return the captured organization IDs, pattern ID, name, raw URL, or request headers.

Native acceptance waits for exactly one successful endpoint POST whose parsed owned name and body organization are present, then asserts body-versus-selected, header-versus-body, and header-versus-selected agreement before target selection or lookup. Any failed assertion leaves the overall native report status fail.

Focused node:test run passed all 8 observer cases, including correct-header acceptance, missing/wrong-header rejection, case-insensitive header-name acceptance, selected-organization mismatch rejection, and delayed request-body capture.
limits: No browser or live T08 run was performed, so this review does not establish that the product emits the correct header or that the native journey passes after the transport fix.
The unit fixture injects CDP-shaped events; it exercises observer logic without a browser-generated Network.requestWillBeSent event.

verdict_b_forcing_guard_and_quality.finding: The original assertion-order finding is ADDRESSED: header/body/selected-org agreement is checked before target selection, lookup, or saved-row success observations. The native acceptance keeps its finally block available for observer shutdown and owned-row cleanup.
evidence: The test's good and bad header values are supplied as outgoing-event inputs, while the observer independently parses the body and compares both observed values to the selected organization; this is more than a fixture echo.
The tests explicitly verify wrong and missing headers fail the shared assertion, and that matching wrong body/header values fail the selected-organization condition.
In the final diff, the acceptance assertion precedes writeTarget, lookupSavedPattern, and saved-row success observations.
Exact request admission is conservative: all matching endpoint POSTs are collected, the wait requires exactly one, and it requires the owned name. This can fail closed on unrelated concurrent POSTs.
required_follow_up: For the native acceptance seam, retain the exact-one-request and owned-name checks; ensure the assertion consumes the same unique request proven by that predicate.
verdict_b_forcing_guard_and_quality.test_result: PASS: 12 tests, 0 failures across observer and observer-wiring focused suites after the final diff. No browser-native execution was performed.
verdict_b_forcing_guard_and_quality.scope: Read-only re-review and focused test execution. No source edits, builds, release, or browser launch.
